page.layout: One page of text, with two engraved medallion portraits at the top centre (their legends are part of the illustrations). Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Single column of running text below the medallions. Signature at bottom right. No margin notes.

main_text.l: AMPHION Iouis & Antiopes filius, Thebis regnauit
anno à mundo condito 2636. ante Christum natum 1326.hic
tam insignis muficus[?] extitit, vt testudinem à Mercurio acce-
pisse dicatur:cuius etiam modulamine fingitur à Poëtis saxa ad
extruendas Thebas illexisse, ac traxisse:quod sic interpretatur
Eusebius in Chro. Fuerunt,inquit,duro corde,&(vt ita dicam)saxei
quidam auditores. Cui concinit Horatius in arte Poëtica,dicens,
&c caetera. Ac paulò post sequitur:

l.i: Saxa mouere sono testudinis,& prece blanda
Ducere quò vellet. fuit haec sapientia quondam

main_text.l: Hic, vi eloquentiae, suasit rudibus ac sparsim degentibus, in
vnum vt conuenirent,ciuitatémque muro cingerent: vel, vt
interpretatur Palephatus, lyrae beneficio Thebanum murum
construxit.
NIOBE filia Tantali, soror Pelopis vxórque Amphionis
fuit,cui elegantissimae formae filios septe ac filias totidem pepe-
rit: vnde se Latonae praetulit: quare indignata Dea hanc in sa-
xum mutauit ( vt fabulantur Poëtae) occisis prius ab Apolline
omnibus suis liberis. Ouid.6.lib.Metamorph.Diodor.lib.5.Pa-
lephatus inde datu locum fabulae scribit, quòd supra natorum
suorum sepulchrum suam ipsius lapideam imaginem Niobe
collocarit, eámq; se efferit ipse quoque Palephatus inspexisse
imaginem.

page.notes: Two medallion engravings at top: left, a helmeted male head with legend "AMPHION" and "THEBANVS"; right, a female head with legend "NIOBE AMPHII" (partly "NIOBE · AMPHII"). Legends are part of the illustrations and are not transcribed as text. "muficus" is partly obscured by a red stain; the reading is doubtful and marked [?]. A red stain also sits over the text near "mufic" and should not be read as printed matter.
